ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a ratio of approximately 85% low-intensity to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region spanning the central fluke and peduncle; high-contrast white mottling and solid patches localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; minor indentations visible on the inner curves of both lobes near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to convex curvature at the outer distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible thin, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (scratches) primarily on the left lobe and upper-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Edge-based irregularities and nicks along the trailing boundary; significant barnacle colonization on leading edges and tips.
